contributions.statement: Lint AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md for style rules already enforced by Checkstyle/Spotless/Sonar (present in most popular config files) and for referenced docs with no note on when to read them, and delete or annotate them; whether this improves agent outcomes is unmeasured.
contributions.evidence: §VI Table II: Lint Leakage 58 confirmed of 100 top-starred repos (93% precision, single author, no recall); Blind References and Context Bloat use unvalidated heuristics; harm asserted from grey literature only (§I, §IV).

reason: The smell catalogue is distilled from 14 grey-literature documents and only its prevalence is measured; the deterministic lint it implies is cheap, but there is no evidence that it helps.
